name: Source Receipt Checker
creator: Applied AI (@applied-ai)
dataHandling: Local CLI by default (local_only). With the opt-in --live flag the tool issues exactly one GET to the receipt's own URL (redirects not followed); no other network activity, no credentials, no uploads, no analytics. The response body is streamed and capped.
description: Check a saved file against a retrieval receipt, offline. Returns three separate outcomes — integrity (bytes vs the pinned sha256), completeness (every required field present AND well-formed, plus the declared constraints on `schema` and `notes`), and format (does the content match its label) — and never collapses them into one verdict. An incomplete or unusable pin leaves integrity 'unknown', never 'failed'. 0.3.0 introduced an opt-in --live mode (one GET to the receipt's own URL); 0.3.1 makes the live declaration match the code: redirects are NOT followed ('redirected'), the timeout covers headers and body, and the body is capped ('too_large').

liveKnobs.SOURCE_RECEIPT_LIVE_TIMEOUT_MS: request timeout covering headers AND body; default 10000

policies.schemaAlignment: the bundled schema and the CLI agree: contentSha256 pattern is ^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$ (case-insensitive digest) with the uppercase-normalization documented in the schema description
policies.completeness: checks presence AND schema well-formedness (type / enum / digest format), and validates declared constraints on optional fields when present (the const on `schema`, the string type on `notes`); missing and invalid are reported in separate arrays
policies.digestCase: uppercase hex digests are accepted and normalized to lowercase for comparison; the normalization is reported as integrity.pin.normalized
policies.unusablePin: a contentSha256 that is not 64 hex characters is an unusable pin: integrity is 'unknown', never a byte mismatch
policies.errors: unreadable / malformed / non-object receipt and unreadable target files return a stable JSON input error with exit 2, never a stack trace
policies.live: opt-in (--live); EXACTLY ONE GET to the receipt's own URL; no credentials; redirects are NOT followed (a 3xx is 'redirected'); the timeout covers headers and body; the body is streamed and capped ('too_large' rather than compared). 'unreachable' is absence of evidence, never evidence of removal

trustCues: offline by default: no network request unless you pass --live; no analytics, no credentials, no payments
example run with expected dispositions declared BEFORE running, across 19 cases including boundary and live cases: fixtures/expected.json + evidence/first-use-run.txt (19/19 matched)
limits: format check is a heuristic (first 512 bytes) and is reported as 'suspected'
completeness validates the fields this schema declares; it is not a general JSON-Schema validator
the --live mode proves whether the fetched body matches the pin; it does not establish live availability, authenticity, or why a source did not answer ('unreachable' ≠ 'removed')
redirects are deliberately not followed, so a URL that only answers with a 3xx is reported as 'redirected', not resolved
the live tests use a local 127.0.0.1 server; no external host was contacted
says nothing about whether the data is correct, only whether bytes match the pin
notIncluded: any fact-checking, scoring, or judgement of content quality
crawling, scheduling, or monitoring of sources (one opt-in GET per invocation only)
status: draft — not published to any registry; pending review
note: This descriptive manifest is NOT the API submission manifest. The API requires exactly the 17 keys of skill-publication.schema.json; the flat manifest is prepared separately.
